findings.evidence: POS grid renders 5 clickable tiles in category 315 'Frites & Accompagnements' (Frites Seules id=361, Boisson Seule id=362, +3 others). Click on Frites Seules triggers GET /api/admin/item/details/361?surface=pos&branch_id=1 -> HTTP 404. Generic red toast 'Une erreur est survenue. Réessayez.' appears (visible in 04-pos-cart-after-add.png top-right). Cart total stays at 0.00 €. Root cause verified via tinker: ItemCategory::find(315)->channels returns array '[]' (empty), so isVisibleOn('pos') returns FALSE. ItemController::itemDetails at app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ItemController.php:208 aborts 404 on category visibility. The POS grid query is more permissive than the details endpoint -> tile renders but click silently fails. 5 items in this broken category cannot be sold from the POS. Network artifact: 04-pos-cart-after-add.network.json. Console artifact: 04-pos-cart-after-add.console.json (2 errors logged: 404 and '[POS] item/details failed AxiosError' at js/pos-shell.js:1501).
findings.fix_hint: Two-option remediation requiring OWNER GATE. Option A (data fix, 1 line): UPDATE item_categories SET channels=NULL WHERE id=315 — legacy default = visible on every surface per ItemCategory::isVisibleOn line 57. Option B (architectural fix): align the POS grid query with the details endpoint visibility — either (b1) filter the grid to hide items whose category channels disallow pos, OR (b2) relax ItemController::itemDetails to interpret channels=[] as 'legacy compat = visible everywhere'. Option A heals the symptom in 1 line. Option B fixes the broader inconsistency between grid render and details fetch. Owner must decide because cat 315 channels=[] may be intentional (per V1 SECTION 5 dual-channel projection note in ItemCategory.php:44).
